subject: op-spd
title: (R)OP.SPD.------ POL.P.
description: Chart on book p. 187 (SR(TRS)II-43). OP-SPD (option spread) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; POL-P (political policies) is the partner. From the subject: PART (participation) and SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From PART: C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). From SOC-RT-DY: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From C-FO-ACT: MT-INFO (multi-information). From DYM-F: DEC (decentralization). From VT-DY: EXP-CONT (expansion condition).
